clauses.reason: The title and enacting words of EO 10998 state the order's subject, assigning emergency preparedness functions to the Secretary of Agriculture, and the authority under which the President acted, including Reorganization Plan No. 1 of 1958; they operate only through the numbered sections that follow, so they ended with the order. No end of its own appears in the held text of EO 10998: it states no expiry date or condition for this provision. It ended on 1969-10-28 when EO 11490 revoked the whole order: Sec. 3015 of EO 11490 (American Presidency Project transcription) provides, after the words "The following are hereby revoked:", item (6), "Executive Order No. 10998 of February 16, 1962.". Sec. 3014 of EO 11490 preserves existing assignments only "Except as provided by Section 3015", so it does not save this provision.

Section 1 of EO 10998 directs the Secretary of Agriculture to prepare national emergency plans and develop preparedness programs covering food resources, farm equipment, fertilizer and food resource facilities, rural fire control, defense against biological warfare, chemical warfare and radiological fallout pertaining to agricultural activities, and rural defense information and education, designed to develop a state of readiness in those areas for all conditions of national emergency. It was a continuing provision of the order. No end of its own appears in the held text of EO 10998: it states no expiry date or condition for this provision. It ended on 1969-10-28 when EO 11490 revoked the whole order: Sec. 3015 of EO 11490 (American Presidency Project transcription) provides, after the words "The following are hereby revoked:", item (6), "Executive Order No. 10998 of February 16, 1962.". Sec. 3014 of EO 11490 preserves existing assignments only "Except as provided by Section 3015", so it does not save this provision.

Section 2 of EO 10998 defines terms used in the order, beginning with food resources. It was a continuing provision of the order. No end of its own appears in the held text of EO 10998: it states no expiry date or condition for this provision. It ended on 1969-10-28 when EO 11490 revoked the whole order: Sec. 3015 of EO 11490 (American Presidency Project transcription) provides, after the words "The following are hereby revoked:", item (6), "Executive Order No. 10998 of February 16, 1962.". Sec. 3014 of EO 11490 preserves existing assignments only "Except as provided by Section 3015", so it does not save this provision.

Section 3 of EO 10998 assigns the Secretary food functions with respect to food resources, food resource facilities, farm equipment and fertilizer, set out in lettered paragraphs that include resources, requirements, priorities and allocations, salvage and rehabilitation, economic stabilization, and financial aid. It was a continuing provision of the order. No end of its own appears in the held text of EO 10998: it states no expiry date or condition for this provision. It ended on 1969-10-28 when EO 11490 revoked the whole order: Sec. 3015 of EO 11490 (American Presidency Project transcription) provides, after the words "The following are hereby revoked:", item (6), "Executive Order No. 10998 of February 16, 1962.". Sec. 3014 of EO 11490 preserves existing assignments only "Except as provided by Section 3015", so it does not save this provision.

Section 4 of EO 10998 directs the Secretary, in consonance with the national civil defense plans, programs and operations of the Department of Defense under Executive Order No. 10952, to provide facilities protection guidance for assigned food resources facilities, to carry out rural fire functions and rural defense information and education functions, and to maintain damage assessment capability. It was a continuing provision of the order. No end of its own appears in the held text of EO 10998: it states no expiry date or condition for this provision. It ended on 1969-10-28 when EO 11490 revoked the whole order: Sec. 3015 of EO 11490 (American Presidency Project transcription) provides, after the words "The following are hereby revoked:", item (6), "Executive Order No. 10998 of February 16, 1962.". Sec. 3014 of EO 11490 preserves existing assignments only "Except as provided by Section 3015", so it does not save this provision.

Section 5 of EO 10998 directs the Secretary to prepare plans to claim materials, manpower, equipment, supplies and services needed to carry out assigned responsibilities and other essential functions of the Department, and to work with the appropriate agencies on programs to insure availability of such resources in an emergency. It was a continuing provision of the order. No end of its own appears in the held text of EO 10998: it states no expiry date or condition for this provision. It ended on 1969-10-28 when EO 11490 revoked the whole order: Sec. 3015 of EO 11490 (American Presidency Project transcription) provides, after the words "The following are hereby revoked:", item (6), "Executive Order No. 10998 of February 16, 1962.". Sec. 3014 of EO 11490 preserves existing assignments only "Except as provided by Section 3015", so it does not save this provision.

Section 6 of EO 10998 directs the Secretary to assist the Office of Emergency Planning in formulating and carrying out plans for stockpiling strategic and critical materials, to take all possible measures to assure the availability of Commodity Credit Corporation inventories of food resources when and where needed in an emergency, and to develop plans and procedures for the proper utilization of agriculture items stockpiled for survival purposes. It was a continuing provision of the order. No end of its own appears in the held text of EO 10998: it states no expiry date or condition for this provision. It ended on 1969-10-28 when EO 11490 revoked the whole order: Sec. 3015 of EO 11490 (American Presidency Project transcription) provides, after the words "The following are hereby revoked:", item (6), "Executive Order No. 10998 of February 16, 1962.". Sec. 3014 of EO 11490 preserves existing assignments only "Except as provided by Section 3015", so it does not save this provision.

Section 7 of EO 10998 directs the Secretary to provide technical guidance to State and local governments so that planning concerned with the assigned functions will be effectively coordinated, and to maintain relations with the appropriate industries to foster mutual understanding of Federal emergency plans. It was a continuing provision of the order. No end of its own appears in the held text of EO 10998: it states no expiry date or condition for this provision. It ended on 1969-10-28 when EO 11490 revoked the whole order: Sec. 3015 of EO 11490 (American Presidency Project transcription) provides, after the words "The following are hereby revoked:", item (6), "Executive Order No. 10998 of February 16, 1962.". Sec. 3014 of EO 11490 preserves existing assignments only "Except as provided by Section 3015", so it does not save this provision.

Section 8 of EO 10998 directs the Secretary, within the framework of Federal research objectives, to supervise or conduct research directly concerned with carrying out emergency preparedness responsibilities, to designate representatives for necessary ad hoc or task force groups, and to provide advice and assistance to other agencies in planning for research in areas involving the interests of the Department of Agriculture. It was a continuing provision of the order. No end of its own appears in the held text of EO 10998: it states no expiry date or condition for this provision. It ended on 1969-10-28 when EO 11490 revoked the whole order: Sec. 3015 of EO 11490 (American Presidency Project transcription) provides, after the words "The following are hereby revoked:", item (6), "Executive Order No. 10998 of February 16, 1962.". Sec. 3014 of EO 11490 preserves existing assignments only "Except as provided by Section 3015", so it does not save this provision.

Section 9 of EO 10998 sets the guidance by which the Secretary, in carrying out the functions assigned in the order, is to be guided: interagency cooperation, Presidential coordination (the Director of the Office of Emergency Planning is to advise and assist the President in determining policy for the performance of functions under the order and in coordinating them with the total national preparedness program), and emergency planning (emergency plans, programs and organization are to be developed as an integral part of the continuing activities of the Department of Agriculture on the basis that it will have responsibility for carrying them out during an emergency, and the Secretary is to be prepared to implement all appropriate plans developed under the order). It was a continuing provision of the order. No end of its own appears in the held text of EO 10998: it states no expiry date or condition for this provision. It ended on 1969-10-28 when EO 11490 revoked the whole order: Sec. 3015 of EO 11490 (American Presidency Project transcription) provides, after the words "The following are hereby revoked:", item (6), "Executive Order No. 10998 of February 16, 1962.". Sec. 3014 of EO 11490 preserves existing assignments only "Except as provided by Section 3015", so it does not save this provision.

Section 10 of EO 10998 provides that nothing in the order is to be construed as conferring authority under Title III of the Federal Civil Defense Act of 1950, as amended, or otherwise, to put into effect any emergency plan, procedure, policy, program, or course of action prepared or developed pursuant to the order, and states that such authority is reserved to the President. It was a continuing provision of the order. No end of its own appears in the held text of EO 10998: it states no expiry date or condition for this provision. It ended on 1969-10-28 when EO 11490 revoked the whole order: Sec. 3015 of EO 11490 (American Presidency Project transcription) provides, after the words "The following are hereby revoked:", item (6), "Executive Order No. 10998 of February 16, 1962.". Sec. 3014 of EO 11490 preserves existing assignments only "Except as provided by Section 3015", so it does not save this provision.

Section 11 of EO 10998 authorizes the Secretary to redelegate within the Department of Agriculture the functions assigned to him in the order. It was a continuing provision of the order. No end of its own appears in the held text of EO 10998: it states no expiry date or condition for this provision. It ended on 1969-10-28 when EO 11490 revoked the whole order: Sec. 3015 of EO 11490 (American Presidency Project transcription) provides, after the words "The following are hereby revoked:", item (6), "Executive Order No. 10998 of February 16, 1962.". Sec. 3014 of EO 11490 preserves existing assignments only "Except as provided by Section 3015", so it does not save this provision.

The first sentence of Section 12 of EO 10998 provides that, to the extent of any inconsistency between the provisions of any prior order and the provisions of this order, the latter controls. That rule was a continuing command and stayed in force while the order did. No end of its own appears in the held text of EO 10998: it states no expiry date or condition for this provision. It ended on 1969-10-28 when EO 11490 revoked the whole order: Sec. 3015 of EO 11490 (American Presidency Project transcription) provides, after the words "The following are hereby revoked:", item (6), "Executive Order No. 10998 of February 16, 1962.". Sec. 3014 of EO 11490 preserves existing assignments only "Except as provided by Section 3015", so it does not save this provision.

The remaining sentence of Section 12 of EO 10998 revokes Emergency Preparedness Order No. 1, issued earlier by the Director of the Office of Civil and Defense Mobilization. It is a one-time act that was complete when the order was issued; nothing in it continued afterwards. The held text of EO 10998, signed John F. Kennedy on February 16, 1962 at the White House, carries the revocation, so it was performed on that date (no later event is needed). The order as a whole was later revoked on 1969-10-28, but this one-time act had been completed on 1962-02-16.

research_rationale:
EO 10998 (1962-02-16; Assigning emergency preparedness functions to the Secretary of Agriculture) was read in full from the held Federal Register text (27 FR 1524, Federal Register of 1962-02-20), whose file also contains neighbouring material; the order was delimited by its heading and the John F. Kennedy signature line. The dossier's machine segmentation, which cuts sections into lettered fragments and repeats some, was replaced by 14 scopes: one for the enacting words and one for each numbered section. Section 12 is split in two: its first sentence (precedence over inconsistent prior orders) and its closing sentence, which revokes Emergency Preparedness Order No. 1, issued earlier by the Director of the Office of Civil and Defense Mobilization. Its own terms contain no end date, expiry or termination condition. It ended on 1969-10-28 by express revocation in EO 11490, Sec. 3015, item (6), cited from the American Presidency Project transcription (APP node 255823; page record checked: heading, date and text hash agree with the held text) and read for corroboration in the Federal Register print of 34 FR 17567 onward (OCR text), which lists the same order. No amendment, suspension or other instrument naming it is held besides EO 11490, which revokes it. The only other held file naming it by number, besides EO 11490, is the text file of EO 10997, which ends with this order's heading (a neighbouring page) and is not a later instrument. The selected machine searches (U.S. Code, eCFR, Federal Register catalog) are coverage statements read before use; they are leads, not independent review.

savings.reason: Item (6) of Sec. 3015 of EO 11490 revokes EO 10998. In the held American Presidency Project transcription, Sec. 3014 reads: "Except as provided by Section 3015, nothing in this order shall be deemed to derogate from any now existing assignment of functions to any department or agency or officer thereof made by statute, Executive order, or Presidential directives, including Memoranda." Because Sec. 3014 begins with that exception, it does not preserve the revoked order. The end source span cited for this claim runs from "SECTION 501. Functions." through Sec. 3015, that is Parts 5 through 30 of EO 11490. I read Sec. 3014 and Sec. 3015; I did not read the other Parts to decide whether any of them carries this order's commands forward, so no transfer or accrual is claimed and the state is none_after_bounded_search.
